Visit our Help Center if you have more questions.Sling is a flexible TV streaming service that connects you to the best live TV without rigid contracts. Get monthly access to your favorite channels, add just the extras you’ll watch, and stop paying for all the fluff. Need more flexibility? Subscribe to a 1 Day, 3 Day or 7 Day Pass anytime to upgrade with minimal commitment or watch 600+ free channels with Freestream.Subscribers can record live TV and save it to their DVR with 50 hours of free DVR storage, and can extend to unlimited storage by adding Unlimited DVR for just $5/mo. Sling’s DVR is in the cloud, which means you can watch your recorded content from any logged-in device, wherever you have Wi-Fi. Local Now, AAC Network Extra, SEC Network+, Pluto, and any local channels added with an over-the-air antenna can’t be recorded.Sling Orange subscribers can watch on 1 device at a time. Sling Blue, Sling Latino, and Sling International subscribers can watch on up to 3 devices at once. Sling Orange & Blue subscribers can watch on up to 4 devices at a time. However, there’s a few channels exclusive to Sling Orange that cannot be streamed simultaneously. You can watch 1 of your Sling Orange exclusive channels and up to 3 other channels at once. Learn more about multi-device streaming.We have an ever-changing list of thousands of TV shows and movies available on demand! Use the search bar in your guide to see if your favorites are available.Monthly subscribers can cancel anytime by visiting their account. You’ll continue to have access to Sling until the period you’ve paid for ends and won’t be charged again until you resubscribe. Cancellation isn't necessary for 1 Day, 3 Day, or 7 Day Passes. Your subscription will end automatically and you won't be charged again until the next time you order a Sling pass or service. Sling is proud to have flexible options. Come and go as you please! Start watching live sports, news, and entertainment in just a few steps. 1. Create an account 2. Choose your channel lineup 3. Start watching You can also watch Freestream until you’re ready to decide on the best plan for you! No account needed. You’ll need a reliable internet connection of at least 3 Mbps and a supported device. Sling works on streaming devices, smart TVs, mobile phones, computers, tablets, and more! For a great experience watching on multiple devices, an internet speed of 25 Mbps is recommended. Check your internet speed. Although there’s no free trial for Sling, a 1 Day Pass is a great way to try out a Sling Orange subscription and decide if it’s a good fit. Anyone can watch limited channels on Freestream at no charge, and access doesn’t end after a few days like a free trial!
